netlifyRouting: netlify.toml:12-15 rewrites /api/* -> /.netlify/functions/:splat. Background worker netlify/functions/generate-background.ts (type 'background', generate-background.ts:132) via POST {origin}/.netlify/functions/generate-background (_shared/trigger.ts:27-33).

methodHandling.otherMethods: Not checked. GET/HEAD (no body) -> req.json() throws -> 500 {"error":"Internal error"} after auth; other methods with a JSON body behave like POST.

auth.notes: Auth first. 401 'Missing bearer token' / 401 'Invalid or expired session'.

request.parse: payload = await req.json() (generate.ts:18). Malformed JSON -> 500 'Internal error'. JSON null -> TypeError reading payload.presentationTitle -> 500 'Internal error'.

fields.name: presentationTitle
fields.validation: zod storylineSchema.parse — failure throws ZodError -> 500 {"error":"Internal error"} (NOT 400)

fields.name: slides
fields.validation: zod; each slide per slideSchema below. Failure -> 500 'Internal error'

fields.name: slides[].number
fields.bounds: positive int; duplicates not rejected by zod but violate DB unique(deck_id, number) -> 500 after the deck row is inserted

fields.name: slides[].type
fields.type: enum SLIDE_TYPES (title, agenda, framework, data, process, quote, closing, comparison, timeline, kpi, market, org, divider, table, case-study, charter, synthesis, navigator, benchmark, scorecard, deep-dive, map)

fields.name: slides[].framework
fields.validation: zod; then repairStoryline coerces non-furniture frameworks to a library framework (warning, never rejection)

fields.name: slides[].bullets
fields.bounds: each min length 1; max 4 items; at least 3 items unless type is divider/title/closing/agenda/navigator

fields.name: slides[].chartData
fields.type: {categories: string[] (min1), series: [{name, values: number[], dataLabels?: string[]}] (min1)}
fields.validation: zod; dropped with a warning if the (repaired) framework is not a chart

fields.name: slides[].prompt
fields.validation: IGNORED — stripped by zod (unknown key) and re-assembled server-side

fields.name: inputs
fields.validation: Not validated. Persisted verbatim to decks.inputs (includes creationMethod and any unknown keys). Read: inputs.brandId (string only), inputs.styleInstructions (string only), inputs.language ('ar' only, else English), inputs.creationMethod (string only), and normalizeKit(kit, inputs) uses legacy primaryColor/accentColor/fontStyle/company

fields.name: intakeSessionKey
fields.validation: used only if typeof string; links intake transcript to the deck (fire-and-forget)

request.unknownFields: Top-level unknown fields ignored (e.g. `warnings` from storyline-status result). Unknown slide keys stripped by zod (default strip). Unknown keys inside `inputs` persisted verbatim.

checkOrder: 5. assemble prompts per slide (content-only tile vs layout hint)
6. persistDeck (decks row status 'generating' + slides rows) -> deckId
7. fire-and-forget: incrementDeckCounters, decks update {slide_count, brand_id, creation_method, generation_started_at}, linkTranscriptToDeck
9. writeJobState(initJobState(deckId, slides)) — all slides 'idle', no brandId
10. triggerBackground({deckId, userId, brandId, language, slides:[{number,type,framework,archetypeId,prompt}]}) — failures swallowed

warnings: Slide 2: "spider chart" isn't buildable from native PowerPoint shapes — using "weighted scoring matrix" instead

errors.when: malformed JSON; null body; ANY storyline validation failure (ZodError is not an HttpError); unknown slide type; DB errors (persistDeck, setSlidePrompt, duplicate slide number); Blobs write failure

sideEffects: decks insert {owner, title: payload.presentationTitle, inputs: payload.inputs, storyline (repaired), status:'generating'} and slides rows {deck_id, number, title, framework, description, bullets, prompt:''} (_shared/db.ts:35-61)
decks update slide_count/brand_id/creation_method/generation_started_at; rpc increment_deck_counters; intake_transcripts link — all fire-and-forget, errors not awaited (generate.ts:57-66)
externalCalls: Supabase (service role). Background: OpenAI gpt-image per slide — PAID (generate-background.ts, _shared/generateCore.ts)
quirks: Validation failures return 500 'Internal error', not 400 — the Connector documents this: 'api/generate 500s (undocumented) unless EVERY slide has a non-empty title, framework, description, type, and 3-4 bullets' (Auxi_Connector app/api/routes/forge.py:328-330).
No daily deck cap is enforced here (reserve_deck/incrementProfileDeckCount is not called; only analytics counters).
Client-supplied slide `prompt` is always discarded (generate.ts:33-36 comment, lines 37-52).
Framework coercions are warnings, never rejections; warnings returned in the 202 body.
Partial failure leaves an orphan deck: persistDeck commits the decks row before the slides insert, and later steps can 500 after the deck exists.
Trigger failures swallowed: 202 returned, job state stays all 'idle' and /api/status never reaches done.
Initial job state is written without brandId/masterUsed; /api/status before the background writes returns masterApplied:false, no masterSkipReason.
Slide numbers are kept as submitted; dividers are NOT inserted here (insertDividers runs only in storyline-background.ts:20).
beforeAnyState: Creates new state. Brand: an unknown/unreachable brandId silently falls back to profiles.brand_kit then defaults (_shared/db.ts:322-328).

tests.asserts: 202 {deckId}; server-assembled prompts contain 'Non-negotiable rules:'; framework coercion to 'weighted scoring matrix' with warnings; brandId threaded to resolveBrandKitRaw and trigger; language 'ar' threaded; style override (lines 34-110). No error-path tests.

callers.where: src/lib/api.ts:141-153 (postGenerate: spreads storyline-status result, adds inputs.creationMethod and intakeSessionKey)

callers.expects: status < 400 and JSON deckId (non-empty) else 502; forwards only slide fields number,title,framework,description,type,bullets (forge.py:99,343) and inputs {topic,company,numSlides,audience,style,brandId?,styleInstructions?,primaryColor?,accentColor?} (forge.py:386-415)
